title: mhng-plugins
summary: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace bundling installable skills, commands, and agents for Claude Code. Its privacy-data-sharing skill embeds Python code that builds SDV metadata and trains GaussianCopula, CTGAN, and TVAE synthesizers, then evaluates them with SDV's run_diagnostic/evaluate_quality and sdmetrics' QualityReport, packaging SDV as an on-demand synthetic-data-generation capability for the AI agent.
evidence: plugins/privacy-data-sharing/skills/privacy-data-sharing/SKILL.md:61-98, shows GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer instantiated and fit(), with evaluate_quality and QualityReport used
needs: privacy-data-sharing plugin is not listed in the README's 'Available plugins' table, so its rollout/maturity relative to the rest of the marketplace is unclear
